body:
Version 2.2.5

Framework:

- [Fix] BUG-10199 Fix build errors on macOS ARM64: SSE compiler flags
        were added on non-x86 architectures, and missing cstddef include
        for size_t in dac.h.

OsTIrus:

- [Fix] BUG-10192 TrancyTI skin: fix swapped OSC Wavetable/Wave panels
        and incorrect Filter header showing Envelope 4.
- [Fix] BUG-10204 Fix LFO 2 destination names in mod matrix showing as
        "LFO >" instead of "LFO 2>" and move them after LFO 2 Assign Amt
        in the destination list.
- [Fix] BUG-10191 TrancyTI skin: fix oversized Reverb disable overlays
        blocking the Feedback knob, and tiny scrollbar in Preset Browser.
- [Fix] BUG-10206 Fix Part Volume knobs showing -64 in Multi mode.
        The multi dump parser only accepted PAGE_D (TI globals) but
        dropped PAGE_C (per-part multi params like Part Volume). Now
        accepts both pages.
- [Fix] BUG-10201 Part button ROM preset menu now shows a checkmark
        next to the currently selected preset.

Osirus:

- [Fix] BUG-10201 Part button ROM preset menu now shows a checkmark
        next to the currently selected preset.
